messages:
sam: Ran nightly perf, saw regression on multi-GPU comm/compute overlap after r1c3f6. Throughput down ~18%.
ricardo: details? kernel selection changed?
sam: Looks related to KV prefetch + cudaGraph capture order. nvtx shows prefetch launched into default stream, capture then replays and host-syncs.
maya: can you drop the perf trace here?
sam: paste: ```
NVTX: prefetch:start (stream 1)
CUDA_GRAPH_CAPTURE_BEGIN (stream 0)
allreduce:start (stream 0)
host_sync wait at cudaGraphReplay
``` 
ricardo: aha. so capture on stream 0 isn't capturing prefetch, so replay causes reorder.host sync.
jing: repro'd locally. when capture overlaps prefetch, the graph inserts implicit host sync at replay on some driver versions.
sam: also saw kernel fallback selection for allreduce (float32->int8 path) after the commit. maybe kernel chosen blocks on event.
maya: quick workaround: disable cudaGraph for kv-prefetch or pin prefetch to the same stream that we capture. safer: prewarm KV cache before capture.
ricardo: workaround accepted. I'll push a toggle: `runtime.disable_cuda_graph_for_prefetch=true`
infra-bot: deploy queued to staging (job 4921)
sam: note: batching heuristics may be exacerbating this — larger batch windows increase chance prefetch in flight during capture.
jing: perf counters from my run: `SM occupancy drop ~12%`, `allreduce wait time +26ms`
ricardo: plan: (1) add capture-aware prefetch (move prefetch to capture stream or postpone), (2) modify kernel selection to prefer non-blocking allreduce kernels when capture is enabled, (3) add test harness for capture+prefetch microbench.
sam: flagged as P0 for this sprint. I'll open issue and link traces.
maya: cc @noah for KV cache policy input
ricardo: assigning to me. will iterate on PR today.
sam: thanks — follow-up once staging perf validates.
infra-bot: deploy to staging succeeded (job 4921) :rocket:
ricardo: pushed initial flag + unit tests, running CI.
sam: great. keep updates short here.
